Product Specialist - Technical Support & Data Analysis

Product Specialist - Technical Support & Data Analysis

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Data Analysis to support customers and colleagues using our cell-counting instruments. In this role, you will combine cell culture biology with data analysis to help users achieve reliable results, investigate unexpected data, and turn insights into product improvements. The ideal candidate holds a PhD in a relevant field, has hands-on cell culture experience, and enjoys working with data in Python.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on data analysis and one on documentation. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with R&D, QA, Field Application Scientists, and commercial teams. You will provide application and technical support, analyze instrument and experimental data, and contribute to the successful testing and launch of new products.

This position is based at our headquarters. The role includes occasional travel, both domestically and internationally, depending on needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide application and technical support for our instruments, helping customers and colleagues with assay setup, sample preparation, and interpretation of results.

• Analyze customer and internal data sets to identify the root causes of unexpected results and recommend solutions.

• Write and maintain Python scripts to automate data analysis, visualization, and reporting.

• Design and analyze experiments and comparison studies for new features and product releases.

• Support product launches with a focus on application readiness, validation data, and training.

• Contribute to technical documentation, including application notes, troubleshooting guides, and data analysis protocols.

• Assist in troubleshooting instrument software, including reading logs to support root cause analysis.

Qualifications

• PhD in Cell Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Science, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience with cell culture and common cell-based assays.

• Solid statistical knowledge, including experimental design and method comparison (e.g., precision, linearity, and regression analysis).

• Strong data analysis and data visualization skills.

• Experience with Python scripting for data analysis (e.g., pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib).

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical workflows and regulated lab environments (e.g., GMP) is a strong advantage.

• Structured, curious, and detail-oriented, with a passion for problem-solving.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with software debugging and troubleshooting, such as reading code and log files.

• Experience with cell counting, image cytometry, flow cytometry, or microscopy.

**

Why join ChemoMetec?**

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

**

Practical information**

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

Please attach a motivation letter and a resume.

Are you passionate about renewable energy and motivated by turning complex needs into practical solutions? PEAK Wind is seeking a consultant to support product and project delivery across Data & Intelligence. You will help drive the delivery of our data, analytics, reporting, and digital solutions. This is a hands-on role for someone who can connect clients, renewable energy specialists, and technical teams, and who enjoys taking responsibility from the first conversation to a solution that creates measurable value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s operations management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, digital products, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work closely with colleagues across D&I, Asset Management, Engineering, HSEQ, Finance, and Business Development. You will coordinate day-to-day delivery with data engineers, data scientists, developers, and renewable energy specialists, while acting as a clear and trusted point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders.

How You Will Make an Impact

In this role, you will combine product ownership with project delivery, turning business and client needs into well-defined, commercially sound, and successfully delivered D&I solutions. You will take ownership of selected products and projects, create structure around delivery, and ensure that commitments move from proposal and plan to implementation, adoption, and follow-up.

Your work will span both recurring services and new opportunities. This includes day-to-day ownership of selected digital products, coordination of analytics and reporting solutions based on operational and SCADA data, and delivery of selected AI and automation initiatives. You will help ensure that our products and services solve real operational problems rather than becoming isolated technical exercises.

On smaller assignments, you may own the full process from client dialogue and scoping through delivery and handover. On larger assignments, you will work with a multidisciplinary team and keep scope, responsibilities, budget, timeline, quality, and stakeholder expectations aligned. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Own and coordinate selected D&I client projects and internal initiatives from initial need and scoping through delivery, adoption, and follow-up

• Translate operational and commercial challenges into clear requirements, work packages, priorities, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans for technical teams

• Take day-to-day ownership of selected digital products and reporting solutions, including backlog management, stakeholder coordination, implementation planning, user feedback, and continuous improvement

• Coordinate analytics and reporting use cases involving SCADA data, availability, production losses, alarms, asset performance, and operational reporting

• Support proposals and commercial scoping by defining deliverables, assumptions, team setup, effort, pricing input, risks, dependencies, and expected client value

• Act as the link between clients, renewable energy specialists, Product Owners, data engineers, data scientists, and software developers

• Manage delivery governance, including progress tracking, budgets, risks, decisions, actions, dependencies, and clear communication to stakeholders

• Drive selected AI, reporting, and automation initiatives together with technical specialists, ensuring that solutions are useful, governed, and adopted

• Challenge requests constructively, clarify the underlying problem, and recommend a simpler or non-technical solution when that creates better value

• Create clear documentation, client material, handovers, and ways of working so solutions can be operated, supported, and scaled

• Capture lessons learned and contribute to D&I frameworks, templates, playbooks, product roadmaps, and continuous improvement across PEAK Wind

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your ability to create clarity, build trust, and get valuable work delivered. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in engineering, renewable energy, data, business, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent track record from technical consulting or digital delivery

• Experience managing client-facing projects, digital products, analytics solutions, or operational improvement initiatives from scope to implementation

• A strong understanding of project and product delivery, including requirements, prioritisation, planning, budgets, risks, stakeholder management, and handover

• The ability to work across commercial, operational, and technical topics and translate effectively between specialists and decision-makers

• Experience preparing proposals, scopes of work, estimates, presentations, or business cases, with an understanding of how delivery choices affect client value and profitability

• Professional experience in renewable energy, asset management, operational analytics, or another complex technical environment; wind operations, SCADA, availability, or performance reporting experience is a strong advantage

• Familiarity with data and digital products such as Power BI, APIs, cloud platforms, reporting systems, workflow automation, or AI-enabled solutions; hands-on software development is not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, and confidence working directly with clients and senior stakeholders

• A structured and pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with the initiative to create momentum when requirements are incomplete or responsibilities are unclear

• Sound commercial judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to balance quality, timeline, effort, and business value

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to stay calm, constructive, and accountable in an international, cross-functional environment

We care more about your ability to structure ambiguity, build strong relationships, and deliver useful outcomes than about a specific job title or number of years.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A central role in shaping and delivering data, analytics, reporting, and digital solutions that directly support renewable energy assets and client decision-making

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• A broad role with direct exposure to clients, commercial decisions, operational challenges, and modern data and AI solutions

• A flat organisational structure where you can take ownership, challenge constructively, and see the result of your work

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth across product, project, commercial, and renewable energy disciplines

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

Would you like to connect people, processes, and technology in an international company?

At Aller Aqua Group, we are looking for an ERP Coordinator who enjoys working closely with people across the organization and turning business needs into practical digital solutions.

You will become part of our Group IT team and play an important role in the continued development and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central across our international companies.

This is an opportunity to combine your ERP knowledge with collaboration, coordination, and business development in a role where your ideas and contributions will be visible.

The role

As our ERP Coordinator, you will act as a link between users, business functions, external partners, and Group IT.

You will help colleagues get the most from Business Central and contribute to solutions that make every day processes simpler, more consistent, and more effective.

Your responsibilities will include:

• coordinating Business Central projects from initial need to implementation

• understanding business processes and translating user needs into practical solutions

• supporting and advising colleagues on how to use Business Central effectively

• contributing to the design, testing, and implementation of new features and processes

• coordinating activities with external Business Central partners and developers

• ensuring clear documentation and quality assurance

• supporting integrations with other systems

• planning training and providing support to key users

• contributing to the future roadmap and governance of Business Central

What you bring

You may have gained your experience through different roles or career paths. Perhaps you have worked as an ERP consultant, application specialist, system coordinator, finance systems specialist, superuser, or in a business function with responsibility for Business Central.

We would particularly value:

• experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or an earlier version of NAV

• an understanding of one or more ERP areas, such as finance, purchasing, inventory, production, or sales

• an interest in how systems can support people and business processes

• experience translating business needs into system requirements or improvements

• the ability to communicate clearly with users, managers, and technical specialists

• professional working proficiency in Danish and English

Experience from a manufacturing company is helpful, but it is not essential if you bring relevant ERP and process knowledge from another environment.

Knowledge of international ERP rollouts, reporting, Power BI, SQL, integrations, or data migration would also be welcome. We do not expect you to be an expert in every area from your first day.

Who you are

You create trust and enjoy working with colleagues who have different professional and cultural backgrounds.

You listen, ask questions, and take the time to understand what users need before identifying a solution. You work in a structured way, follow up on your commitments, and are comfortable coordinating several stakeholders.

You are curious and motivated by learning. Most importantly, you enjoy helping people and systems work better together.

What we offer

At Aller Aqua, you will have the opportunity to:

• influence the development of an international ERP platform

• work closely with colleagues across business functions and countries

• develop your knowledge of Business Central and international business processes

• take responsibility while receiving support and professional sparring from your colleagues

• contribute your ideas in an organization where the path from suggestion to action is short

• work under flexible conditions in an informal and collaborative environment

You will become part of Group IT, which currently consists of five colleagues, and report to our Group IT Manager.

Why Aller Aqua?

Aller Aqua is a family-owned company with headquarters in Christiansfeld. We develop and produce fish feed for freshwater and marine aquaculture and serve customers in international markets.

You will join a workplace with colleagues from around the world and become part of a professionally strong team. Here, you can use your experience while continuing to develop your skills and contribute to digital solutions that support our international business.

Our culture is characterized by collaboration, responsibility, innovation, and openness to different perspectives. We believe that our best solutions are created when people share their knowledge and work together across functions and locations. Aller Aqua’s internal competency framework similarly emphasizes collaboration, inclusion, knowledge sharing, and learning from different viewpoints and experiences.

Interested?

If the role appeals to you, but you do not meet every qualification listed, we would still be pleased to hear from you. Your experience may have given you relevant skills in ways we have not described here.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, perspectives, and career paths. All candidates will be assessed according to the same role-relevant and objective criteria, in line with Aller Aqua’s internal approach to recruitment and pay structures.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Group IT Manager Kenneth Lunby by phone at +45 40 21 80 88 or by email at klb@aller-aqua.com

Place of work: Aller Aqua A/S, Allervej 130, Aller, 6070 Christiansfeld, Denmark

jobs.description:
Department of Mathematical Sciences, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen

   

  Department of Mathematical Sciences (MATH) invites applicants for PhD stipends in mathematics.

  The start date is ordinarily September 1, 2027, but can be subject to negotiation.

  There will be PhD stipends available in:

   	
• Algebraic and Arithmetic Geometry, Applied algebra, Combinatorics, Geometric group theory, Geometry and Geometric Analysis, Number Theory, Representation Theory, and Topology as covered by the section Algebra & Geometry and  Copenhagen Center for Geometry & Topology (GeoTop).    	
• Classical Analysis, Descriptive Set Theory, Functional Analysis, Geometric group theory, Harmonic Analysis, History of Mathematics, Mathematical Physics, Operator Algebras, Partial Differential Equations, Quantum Information, Quantum Computation and Quantum Simulation as covered by the section Analysis and Quantum, the Centre for the Mathematics of Quantum Theory  and the Quantum for Life Center.   You are welcome to contact any member of the department to discuss research projects.

   

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates within the field of Mathematics or nearby fields, whose background and research interests are a strong fit with the areas of mathematics above.

  About the department

  The department has about 50 permanent scientific staff members; around 60 PhD students and 35 postdocs. It has strong research groups in many areas of mathematics, and active PhD, postdoc, and visitors’ programs. Our buildings are located in central Copenhagen next to the central park Fælledparken. Our website http://www.math.ku.dk/english provides more information about the department and the research  conducted at the department https://www.math.ku.dk/english/research/.  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment.

  You can find more information about the PhD program on the homepage http://www.math.ku.dk/english/programmes/ph.d/. 

   

  The PhD programme 

  Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as either:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelor’s degree.

  ********************************************************************************

  Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. mathematics or closely related. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  Terms of appointment and payment according to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor’s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.  

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled in one of the faculty’s master’s programmes in Mathematics or Quantum Information Science.

  Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years, and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

  Until the MSc degree is obtained, (when exactly two years of the full 3+5 programme remains), the grant will be paid partly in the form of up to 48 state education grant portions (in Danish: “SU-klip”) plus salary for work (teaching, supervision etc.) totalling a workload of 150 working hours per year. A PhD grant portion is currently (2026) DKK 7.426 before tax.
 
 When you have obtained the MSc degree, you will transfer to the salary-earning part of the scholarship for a period of two years. At that point, the terms of employment and payment will be according to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

   

  Responsibilities and tasks in both PhD programmes

   	
• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme  (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme) 	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision 	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications and experience:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other relevant professional experience, including publications (if any) 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in Mathematics 	
• Good English skills    

  Application and Assessment Procedure

  Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, publications (if any), language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor’s or Master’s and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Reference letters (if available; letters can be uploaded as part of the application or sent to hr-math@adm.ku.dk by the reference person).   When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

   

  Application deadline: 

  The deadline for applications is 15 November 2026, 23:59 GMT+1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment (shortlisted) by a committee of unbiased experts. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

  An assessment committee will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the research area, skills and other requirements. The assessors will conclude whether each applicant is qualified. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

Our website http://www.math.ku.dk/english provides more information about the department and the research conducted at the department https://www.math.ku.dk/english/research/.  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment.

  You can find more information about the PhD program on the homepage http://www.math.ku.dk/english/programmes/ph.d/. 

   

  The PhD programme 

  Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as either:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelors´s degree.

  ********************************************************************************

  Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. [relevant educations]. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant with the help of the supervisor.

  Terms of appointment and payment according to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor´s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.  

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled at one of the faculty’s master programmes. Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

  Until the MSc degree is obtained (when exactly two years of the full 3+5 programme remains), the grant will be paid partly in the form of up to 48 state education grant portions (in Danish: “SU-klip”) plus salary for work (teaching, supervision etc.) totalling a workload of 150 working hours per year. A PhD grant portion is currently (2026) DKK 7.426 before tax.
 
 When you have obtained the MSc degree, you will transfer to the salary-earning part of the scholarship for a period of two years. At that point, the terms of employment and payment will be according to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  ***************************************************************************

• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme) 	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision 	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teach and carry out knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at internationally recognized journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project    

  We are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and experience:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other relevant professional experience, including publications (if any) 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in Mathematics and its applications 	
• Good English skills

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, publications (if any), language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor or Master and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Reference letters (if available; letters can be uploaded as part of the application or sent to hr-math@adm.ku.dk by the reference person).   When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment (shortlisted) by a committee of unbiased experts. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

The assessors will conclude whether each applicant is qualified. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

**Senior Development Engineer, VELUX Products & Innovation – Maintenance Free Window Modules – LKR Innovation House - Østbirk

****Join a team of passionate engineers and technical specialists with end-to-end responsibility for critical window modules. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Maintenance Free Window Modules team based in Østbirk. The team has end-to-end responsibility for VELUX sash and frame mo-dules made from polyurethane and other polymers, as well as our Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

Working across the full product lifecycle, the team supports everything from concept creation and new product introduction to continuous optimization of cost, performance, sustainability, and quality. We collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, and other development teams to ensure our products continue to create value for customers and the business.

As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will act as the Module Owner of the IGU module area, driving development activities, shaping future module roadmaps, and ensuring strong cross-functional alignment across the organization.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential technical role with significant impact across products, processes, and stakeholders. You will work with experienced colleagues in an international environment where innovation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration are valued and encouraged.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Hold technical ownership and end-to-end responsibility for Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

• Drive module development activities across new product launches, performance improvements, cost optimization, upgrades, sustainability initiatives, and quality enhancements.

• Conduct module health assessments to evaluate performance, value creation, business relevance, and future opportunities.

• Identify, qualify, and drive opportunities that create value across the product lifecycle and value chain.

• Lead design, concept development, and resolution of complex technical challenges.

• Define and secure technical requirements, module performance, and robust engineering solutions.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment across Product Management, Production, Supply Chain, and Product Development.

• Support management decision-making through technical expertise and insights.

• Act as a knowledge leader by developing technical capabilities, facilitating learning activities, and promoting effective knowledge sharing throughout the organization.

**What You Will Bring

**You enjoy navigating complex technical environments and are motivated by combining deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are able to balance technical excellence with business value.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience working with product development or complex technical products.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges.

• Have experience with CAD tools, preferably CREO and Windchill.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Demonstrate the ability to engage and align stakeholders across functions and disciplines.

• Take a proactive approach and can independently drive activities from concept to implementation.

• Have experience or knowledge into systems engineering, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

• Have experience or knowledge within insulating glass, glazing solutions, or related technologies, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

About the job

GN is entering a new chapter. Following the definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon, this role sits within the Hearing business and offers a unique opportunity to influence the Performance & Reward agenda of a global hearing business at a pivotal point of transition.

Working closely with the Head of Performance & Reward, you will own the pay transparency agenda for the Hearing business while contributing across the broader Performance & Reward agenda. From job architecture and compensation governance to annual reward processes, strategic partnering, and reward philosophy, you will help define how the Hearing business manages performance and reward globally.

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

****What the role is

****We're looking for a Data & Automation Specialist who loves digging into data, and wants to use that foundation to make every team at Onomondo work smarter.

Your starting point is data. You'll work with complex, messy, multi-source data, from billing and revenue to product usage and commercial pipelines and turn it into analysis, dashboards and answers the business can act on. You'll partner with teams across the company (Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Operations) to understand what they need to know, and build the reporting that gets them there.

From that foundation, you'll look for where the data shows us time being lost, and fix it. That might be a script, an integration, a scheduled job, or an AI skill where that is the right approach. Getting there often means untangling messy data or a half-broken process first and you don't shy away from that groundwork when it's what the job actually needs.

AI is a real and growing part of the toolkit here. As you settle in, there's plenty of room to grow into that area. This includes our AI infrastructure and production agent stack, ready to be taken to the next level. Our vision is a backbone data warehouse with all data sources available so that our colleagues can self-service with trust through AI.

You'll report to our Data Analytics Manager, Jonathan, and be part of the Insights team.

****What you'll do

• Working with complex data across billing, revenue, product usage and commercial systems. Cleaning, modelling and making sense of it

• Building dashboards and visualizations that teams actually use to make decisions. We currently use Tableau for most of our complex visualizations, but we foresee leaning into an in-house setup. Groundwork is already in place to allow for broader adoptions and flexibility

• Running deeper analyses on the questions that matter, from revenue and billing trends to customer behavior and operational efficiency

• Finding the manual, repetitive workflows that cost the company the most time, and automating them in whatever form actually fits

• Building and maintaining integrations between the tools teams already use (Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and others)

• Authoring and iterating AI skills where they're the right tool, using Onomondo's existing skill framework

• Growing into deeper AI/agent infrastructure work over time. Connectors, permissioning, production agents and moreNot all at once, of course. We'll start with what matters most, build it to scale, then keep going.

****What we're looking for

• Strong with data: comfortable with SQL, working in a data warehouse (we use BigQuery), and handling complex, imperfect datasets

• Experienced in data visualization and analysis. You can turn a messy question into a clear chart and a clear answer

• Comfortable writing code (Python or similar) to analyse, transform and automate

• A fixer by instinct. You notice friction and want to remove it, without needing to be asked

• Curious about AI, LLMs and agents, and keen to explore how they can make data and processes work better - even if that's not your primary experience yet
